description.default: Visual settings for the Mist theme: per-region colours and opacity, background image, floating-panel glass and pop animation, fonts, doc-tree icons, global contrast. Works only while the Mist theme is active and unloads itself on theme switch.
description.zh-CN: 为「薄雾」主题提供可视化设置：分区颜色与透明度、背景图、浮动面板玻璃与弹出动画、字体字号、文档树图标、全局对比度。仅在薄雾主题下生效，切换主题自动停用。
